result:
All six points are corrected. I haven't built, typechecked or rendered anything, so none of it is verified.

**Changed files**
- `src/components/composition/MenuCollection.astro`
  - The category is now an `h3` and the dish name an `h4` inside each row, with their fact ids and scopes unchanged. The `.menu-title` h2 is untouched.
  - "Ver plato" no longer has an arrow glyph.
- `src/components/composition/DishDetail.astro`
  - `data-required={String(menu.required)}` is on the root.
  - The category now sits below the H1 as a plain metadata line, with its fact attributes kept.
  - The facts are a `dl` with Ingredientes, Alérgenos, Calorías and Moneda labels. Each `dd` holds the full original text with its original id and scope. The labels are presentation only.
  - The arrow glyphs are gone from "Elegir este plato", "Volver a la carta" and "Ver origen en Pixabay".
- `src/components/composition/ExperienceNavigation.astro`: the prop type is now `parentKind?:string|undefined`, which should clear the TS2375 error. Output for old routes is unchanged.
- `src/design/dish-detail.css`
  - **Title sizing:** `.dish-head` is now a size container. The 03 H1 is `clamp(1.625rem, 8cqi, 2.75rem)`, so it scales with the actual title column, at selector specificity above the global ember rule. At 760px and below it is mixed case at `clamp(1.75rem, 9cqi, 2.5rem)`, matching the global ember mobile behaviour. This is meant to keep the longest words such as TEMPORADA inside the column at every width. `artistic-ember.css` is not touched.
  - **Facts and category styling:** there are new `dl`, `dt` and `dd` styles, a plain-metadata category style, and the Masthead category badge is removed.
- `src/design/menu-carta.css`
  - On the 03 menu at 600px and below, the name takes the full row width, in mixed case at about 22–28px. The price drops to its own line at 18px.
  - The 02 category badge is removed, leaving type and rules only.
  - The category keeps the body font, so the `h3` doesn't pick up the wide Syne display face.

**Risks to check in captures**
- **Title scale:** I sized the 03 title from my estimate of how wide Syne's uppercase letters are, not from a measurement. The `cqi` values may need a small tweak after your 100-combination rerun, especially for Verde de temporada and El último bocado at 1024.
- **Other worlds:** the container-query sizing only applies to 03. The other worlds still use the earlier `clamp(2.25rem, 8vw, 4rem)` title. They weren't flagged, but I didn't recheck them.
- **Existing h3/h4 rules:** the menu rows now use `h3` and `h4`. I assumed no other global rule restyles `h4`.
- **Label wording:** the labels are the ones you gave. If your audits match on the old `p` or the old heading text, they may need updating. I kept the "Ingredientes y datos del plato" heading text.
